therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Immunosuppression via calcineurin inhibition and anti-metabolite activity or CD52-targeted cell depletion
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Prevention of graft-versus-host disease and graft rejection in transplantation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with mature B or T-cell neoplasm undergoing transplantation

results.dose_information: Methotrexate on days +1, +3, +6, +11 with folinic acid rescue; Alemtuzumab 20 mg/day IV over 8 hours on days -8 to -4; Cyclosporine from day -7

context.comparator: Cyclosporine plus Methotrexate vs Cyclosporine plus Alemtuzumab
context.duration: 270 days primary endpoint with 1 year follow-up
context.investigator_commentary: The trial was stopped before the targeted number of patients was reached due to lack of support.
